'''Ivor Drake''' was a [[human]] from [[Kestos Minor]] who served as [[senator]] for the [[Kwymar sector]] in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. She joined the [[Delegation of 2,000]], a group concerned with the power of [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] that presented the [[Petition of 2,000]] in the final session of the senate.

After attending the [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] of her friend [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]], Drake was arrested by [[Imperial Intelligence]] and pressured to name her allies. She refused and was incarcerated in [[Arrth-Eno Prison Complex]], where she [[Death|perished]] when the structure was destroyed by Palpatine during a failed [[Arrth-Eno Mission|rescue attempt]] made by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in around [[0 ABY]].

==Biography==
===Downfall of the delegation===
Ivor Drake was a [[human]]<ref name="Dawn" /> from [[Kestos Minor]] who served as [[senator]] for her [[homeworld]]<ref name="Rebel Files" /> and the wider [[Kwymar sector]] in the [[Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. During the war, she joined the [[Delegation of 2,000]], a group of senators who were concerned with the emergency powers that [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]—leader of the Republic—was accumalating throughout the conflict and the fact that there was no formal mechanism for the powers to be removed.<ref name="Dawn" /> The delegation created the [[Petition of 2,000]], which was presented in the senate in what proved to be its final session prior to the transition into the [[Imperial Senate]] as part of the [[Proclamation of the New Order|reformation]] of the Republic into the [[Galactic Empire]] as the Clone Wars drew to a close<ref name="Rebel Files" /> in [[19 BBY]].<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref>

Shortly after the reformation, Drake's friend<ref name="Dawn" /> and fellow senator [[Padmé Amidala Naberrie|Padmé Amidala]] [[Death|died]] and Drake attended her [[Padmé Amidala's funeral|funeral]] in the [[city]] of [[Theed]] on the [[planet]] [[Naboo]]. During the funeral, Drake walked with other senators in a procession behind Amidala's coffin.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> The [[Standard day|day]] after formation of the Empire, Drake was one of many senators from the Delegation of 2,000 [[Senatorial arrests|arrested]] by [[Imperial Intelligence]] and labeled as a traitor in the [[HoloNet News]].<ref name="Rebel Files" /> She was pressured to name her allies, but refused<ref name="Dawn" /> and was incarcerated in the [[Arrth-Eno Prison Complex]] on the planet [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Rebel Files" />

===Incarceration and death===
Several members of the delegation who were not incarcerated went on to found the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] to oppose the Empire and its leader, [[Galactic Emperor]] Palpatine. In [[0 ABY]], they achieved [[Galactic Civil War|successes]] against the Empire on various fronts including an [[Assault on Cymoon|attack]] on [[Cymoon 1]], and in response Palpatine declared that all political [[prisoner]]s in Arrth-Eno, which included Drake, would be [[Death|executed]]. Beliveing that she had the chance to save the prisoners after not being able to save her homeworld, [[Alderaan]], rebel [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] worked with [[General]] [[Davits Draven]] of [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|Alliance Intelligence]] to put together a [[Arrth-Eno Mission|mission]] to extract them.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

Organa sent of summary of the plan to the Alliance's leader [[Mon Mothma]], detailing how undercover [[agent]] [[Eneb Ray]] would be activated for the mission and mentioning that she looked forward to seeing Drake and other prisoners. However, once at the [[prison]]<ref name="Rebel Files" /> in around 0 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|ABY]]<ref name="Death" />, Ray deviated from the plan in order to try and [[assassin]]ate Palpatine. The unsuccessful deviation ultimately led to Palpatine detonating a [[bomb]] that destroyed Arrth-Eno and all those inside,<ref name="Timelines" /> including Drake.<ref name="Death" /> Draven informed Mothma of the mission failure, while the new emotionally devastated Organa.<ref name="Rebel Files" />

==Personality and traits==
Ivor Drake had [[Color|blonde]] [[hair]] and light skin.<ref name="Dawn" />

==Equipment==
Drake wore a mottled brown [[cloak]] over a dark brown [[robe]].<ref name="Dawn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ivor Drake first appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> which was released on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="SWYBY">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> In the current ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]], she was first identified in the [[2017]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''.<ref name="Visual Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first used in "[[Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000]]," which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and published in [[Star Wars Insider 85|''Star Wars Insider'' 85]]<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|85|Who's Who in the Delegation of 2000}}</ref> on [[November 28]], 2005.<ref name="Dates">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20051101.html|text=More Vader in ''Star Wars Insider'' #85}}</ref>
